3. ASSISTANCE/ REFERRAL TO LEARNING SERVICE PROVIDER REGARDING GAD
TRAINING CONCERNS

All offices, departments and agencies including barangay officials and the local government
officials shall undergo capacity-building programs on GAD to ensure the effective
implementation of gender-responsive governance, as mandated by the Magna Carta of Women
(RA 9710), to enhance the ability of local officials to mainstream gender perspectives into
policies, plans, and budgets, and ensures they can identify and address specific gender issues
within their communities.

2. ASSISTANCE/REFERRAL TO LEARNING SERVICE PROVIDER REGARDING GAD
    TRAINING CONCERNS

    All offices, departments and agencies including local government officials shall undergo
    capacity building to enhance their knowledge, skills, and competencies, enabling them to
    perform their roles more efficiently, adapt to changing technological and operational
    landscapes, and improve public service delivery. This process is essential for
    strengthening institutional structures, ensuring good governance, and fostering a culture
    of continuous learning and improved performance, as mandated by the Magna Carta of
    Women (RA 9710).

FEEDBACK AND COMPLAINTS MECHANISM

How to send feedbacks?        Answer the Client Feedback Form available at the

                              receiving desk and drop it at the designated drop box

                              in the same area, or:

                              Contact Information:

                              0912 - 158 - 3909
                              0961 - 401 - 8480
                              gadlegazpihb1@gmail.com

How feedbacks are processed?  Feedbacks and/or complaints are acknowledged and
                              replied via email explaining the process, action taken
                              and disposition to the relevant officer or personnel.

                              For inquiries and follow-ups, Clients may contact the
                              following numbers:

                              0912 - 158 - 3909
                              0961 - 401 – 8480

How to file complaint?        To file a complaint against the GAD DIVISION
                              OFFICE, provide the following details through writing
                              on the Complaint Form (CSC Form No.3), or via e-
                              mail to gadlegazpihb1@gmail.com , to wit:

                              - Full name, address and contact information of the
                              Complainant
                              - Narrative of the Complaint
                              - Evidences
                              - Name of the Person being Complained of
